# LoRa2021F33_2G4 -- generator notes (moved out of the .kicad_mod)

**Why:** these were `;;` comment lines *inside* the footprint. KiCad's S-expression parser has no
comment syntax, so the file would not load and DRC reported `lib_footprint_issues`.
The footprint is GENERATED by `scripts/gen_f33_landpattern.py` -- that generator must stop
emitting `;;` lines, or they will reappear on the next regeneration.

## Verbatim

```
  ;; ================================================================

  ;;   python3 scripts/gen_f33_landpattern.py
  ;; Pad CENTRES decoded from the VENDOR land file

  ;;   pad count 18, names 1..18, 9 per row; rows on the two 39mm
  ;;   edges at y=+/-10.5000; pitch 3.9289mm (drawing 3.93+-0.1);
  ;;   outer pad centre 3.7844mm from the 39mm end (drawing 3.78+-0.1);
  ;;   closure 2*3.7844 + 8*3.9289 = 39.0000mm = module length 39.00.
  ;; VERIFIED land size - DERIVED from the operator-supplied datum:
  ;;   pad LAND SIZE 1.3 x 1.3 mm

  ;;     RULE: land = the castellation aperture grown by a uniform
  ;;       0.25 mm solder-fillet margin on EVERY side.
  ;;       x: D + 2*0.25 = 1.3 mm; gap to the next land = 3.9289 - 1.3 = 2.6289 mm
  ;;       y: D + 2*0.25 = 1.3 mm, symmetric about the pad centre (pinned
```
